notes.title: Major update V 3.11.0, Teen Patti released!
notes.notes:
1. Teen Patti has been tested and released, with more rooms available to join.
2. New animated scenes for a more immersive experience.
3. The Slots Jackpot has been fixed! You can now win the super grand prize from the jackpot pool! Come and try your luck!
4. We know many Texas Hold'em players don't like going all-in before the flop, so we've added a limit-bet room for pre-flop. In this room, players can only raise up to 4 bets before the flop.
5. More Emojis, Words, and Props to send.
6. More dealers are joining soon, and your votes will decide which dealer appears first.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/0801f33198e21faab937b9f0420f541a2703a25d.png

notes.title: Major update V 3.8.0, friend function released ！
notes.notes:
The friend function has been released on all platforms!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/971e4bc556658b7e6626555f30da077e0b7c3467.png

1. Friend application
    You can search for friend IDs, send friend requests, or directly send friend requests in the personal information interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/157b2f6ef8f3452f92d3ae55909a8c4e7a18bc48.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/80c13296467ad20652f7b1e28404a53e76ac0ac3.jpg

2.Friend review
    After receiving a friend request, you have 24 hours to choose to accept or reject the friend request.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/0de3ab5324b2a9858f6d7893bc25e554b20afc9d.png

3. Follow friends
    You can see your friends' game status and follow your friends into the games they are playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/bf80c85e5e3184f515c3481317f0410e64ab8130.jpg

4. Invite friends
    You can invite friends to join your game within the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/810d79be8c2d725f0c38caaa6226e12e0acc3022.jpg

5. Remark names of friends
    You can note the name of your friend to make it easier for you to remember.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/99291f6f2b3055089cc075fb1aa9fd901aaa2fbc.png

6. Delete friends
    You can choose to cancel the friend relationship in your friend's personal information, please use it with caution.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/e02955abe506a709dbaac56593f1981afa828c98.jpg

7. Social Settings
    If you do not want other players to send you friend requests, or do not want to accept game invitations from friends, you can choose to refuse to receive them in the settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/eab14aec25b631a5afc9905e34b38f03f5874d08.jpg

8. Block players
    If you don't want to play with a certain player, you can block them in the personal information interface and you will no longer be matched with that player that day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/9656d624447b3968258f357f9e21429a899b3155.png

9.Report players
    If you find that a player has engaged in illegal gaming behavior, you can report him in the personal information interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/d3ffb87cbe0db12b2457dd1dd70bcce19d834a4d.jpg


    Get fun to make friends with other players, being friendly is a good way to do it.

notes.title: 📢The BETA version of the friend function is released! 🎉🎉🎉
notes.notes:
BETA version released! You can experience the new STEAM friend function first!

1. View friends
     You can view STEAM friend information in the game, and view friend record data

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/57ca048d638e0e3c860a3eb75563ce3f2e84d552.png


2. Invite friends
     You can invite friends to join the game with one click, and there will be gold coin rewards for the first invitation every day

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/7f3179ab25c0af53d19ba9555d8b156169af770d.png


3. New friends
     Invite a friend to join the game for the first time, both parties can get gold coin rewards, after completing 10 games, both parties can get more gold coin rewards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/77e4144049c2518ea0036c9843c804af37098cad.png


4. Follow friends
     You can check the game status of your friends, follow your friends to the poker table, and watch your friends play games

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/7e41773bbf657b90d780b14698bfe01e0d80a4e5.png



How to download the BETA version

1. In the game list, right-click the game to pop up the menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/449b7f76dcd0519f38819242822e2265bbb8d90a.png


2. Select Properties in the popup menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/6074c84b1bb05260e4d4a83b68c60c3542d0e430.png


3. In the property interface, select the beta version, and select "beta version" in the drop-down menu on the right. After closing the interface, the beta version client will be automatically updated

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/895df904a086039f2523233b5d8df461aee06afd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/a29b7ac66878aaca0d746a6a83aadb48198ad0f3.png


4. If you want to switch back to the official version, you can select "None" in the drop-down menu in the property interface, and then the official version client will be reinstalled

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711675/a29b7ac66878aaca0d746a6a83aadb48198ad0f3.png
